name: Rectoratul Politehnicii
replacementScope: Only the Rectorat body and its mapped dome roof part. Adjacent Corp AN w1217713450 and every other campus source identity remain separate.

sources.label: OSM dome roof part; raw levels/min_level/layer retained

improvements: Retained the existing square body outline within 0.4 m of the OSM vertices.
Reworked the main facade with red infill, dark glazing, pale projecting fins/sills, brick lower facade and recessed glazed upper floor from independent 2024 photographs.
Retained a 39.2 m authored dome within the independent aerial estimate of 40 ± 4 m; source diameter is not a surveyed height.
Declared exact body and dome source identities for the shared source-only landmark replacement policy.

Production now combines the exact body/dome declarations from 6e4160cce21d5dcd682e436f216dd8b46fc17e3d with the integrated explicit-ID replacement path 2c73f3d986a4e52d85f5520ca6cb3d4b732f0d13; Corp AN and other undeclared source identities remain separate.
remainingGaps: No independently published metre height is established; storey heights, fin depth, bay count and palette are authored estimates.
Partly exposed lower level and individually altered facade bays are simplified.
Roof part raw building:levels=7, min_level=6, roof:levels=1 and layer=1 are not converted into metric clearance.

The eaa40092 captures retain their original pre-policy provenance. Exact body/dome-only replacement is now implemented and excludes Corp AN w1217713450; the old isolated views do not independently certify every current campus placement, body clearance or whole-campus comparison.
Legacy strip colliders approximate the landmark; the full body/roof collision has not been surveyed.
These elevated front/top/oblique summer captures do not establish matched street-eye, seasonal or whole-campus parity.
